prompt:
Bug report: with the `toc` extension, a heading like `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world-`, with a trailing dash. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: `# Hello world !` now gets the id `hello-world`, and the full test suite passes (the new tests fail without the fix). `slugify` now strips whitespace left behind after punctuation is removed, which also fixes leading dashes like `# ! Hello`. Hyphens typed in the heading are kept on purpose, so `# --help` keeps `-help` and its existing links, but `# Hello world -` still gets `hello-world-`. flake8 isn't installed, so lint wasn't run, and the changelog entry has no `#123` reference because the report gave no issue number.
